answer: California processed 129 waiver requests in 2024: 103 approved, 0 denied, 15 withdrawn, and 11 with no formal action. In 2025, it processed 172: 134 approved, 1 denied, 30 withdrawn, and 7 with no formal action. Thus, 2025 had 43 more requests (a reported 33.33% increase), with 31 more approvals, 1 more denial, 15 more withdrawals, and 4 fewer cases receiving no formal action.
